system.description:
At 5th level, you gain proficiency with Charisma saving throws. Additionally, you learn how to permanently alter clothing in some fantastic way. Choose one of the following options.

Endless Pocket

You gain the ability to turn one of your pockets into a small extradimensional space. You may store up to ¼ of your total carrying capacity in your pocket in this way, and objects in this pocket do not count towards your encumbrance. You may retrieve an item from your pocket as a bonus action.

Tactical Fashionista

You have learned how to marry chemistry and fashion to augment your accessories. You may store an instance of your Tactical Chemistry in some form of fashionable accessory. This could be a lapel flower that squirts acid, a walking cane that can become a torch, or an earring that can be deployed as a smoke bomb. While this chemical creation is more stable than normal instances of Tactical Chemistry, it must be used in a timely fashion or it dissolves as normal. Any stored instances of Tactical Chemistry that are not used within 24 hours of being created melt into useless goo.
